task:
The backend's createIssueSchema and updateIssueSchema accept any string as dueDate, so a value like "next week" is saved as an invalid date.

Only accept a real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form (e.g. 2026-07-01) or a full ISO 8601 UTC timestamp (e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00.000Z); anything else must fail validation. In updates, an empty string must still be accepted, because it clears the due date. Add tests.
